verses.21:46: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةࣱ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

meaning: In the Quran, نَفْحَة denotes a slight touch, breath, or passing waft; 21:46 speaks of even a slight touch of the Lord’s punishment.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
